problem: A selected face could not be removed by a repeated viewport click or its entity-list remove button, especially while the feature preview failed.
causes: Entity-box pointerdown requested current geometry and replaced its rows before the browser dispatched click to the original remove button
Reference replies only added inputs, with no toggle semantics for a direct viewport click
implementation: Shared face/edge picker resolves the exact clicked item and toggles its canonical reference; other input references remain intact
Row buttons activate the picker without refreshing away the click target; removal uses reference identity instead of a stale row index
Idempotent updates preserve existing row elements, and nested preview selection updates cannot reenter a reference request
The same path handles source geometry while creating or editing features, independently of transient viewport selection

qualification.before: Both new DOM regressions fail on the prior implementation
qualification.browser_cases: Fillet and Chamfer, both conical faces on a disposable copy of the reported Part 1
checks: Click-to-deselect during valid and failed previews
Two faces with identical display names: each remove button removes only its exact reference
Removing the final reference clears the persisted red outline
Re-add, correct radius to 0.020 inches, native preview, apply, save and reload
Reopened history edit: remove with the button, re-add, remove in the viewport and cancel without saving the draft
qualification.modeling_browser: All 17 native steps passed with zero server geometry requests
qualification.picking_profile: Chromium/WebKit, one and 65 bodies, 300 rays each: zero hit/triangle mismatches
qualification.native_worker: Byte-identical to qualified CAD alpha-0.1.104; no kernel/document changes in this release

remaining_scope: The full user reference list and themed reference-format windows remain the active objective. Extrude native stopping/draft work is separate and is not included in this selection-only release.
